steps: Draw four lines m in different directions: across, up and down, and two slanting ways.
For each, mark a point B off the line and draw a transversal l through B cutting m at A.

Draw equal arcs from A and from B. The arc from A cuts m at C and l at D; the arc from B cuts l at F, on the side of B away from A. The chord CD is transferred to the arc from B, starting at F and on the same side of l as C, to give E.
Draw n through B and E. AD = BF, AC = BE and DC = FE, so ΔADC ≅ ΔBFE by SSS and the corresponding angles are equal.
So each n is parallel to its m.
